premise_review: All twelve theorem declarations and their exact fully qualified delegated proof terms are retained in raw/organized archives. This is not a theorem-free source, even though it constructs no new mathematical bridge.

The four spectrum/object conclusions are arbitrary selfAdjointLike/discreteSpectrum/compactResolventLike/categoricalObject propositions whose witnesses are supplied by the captured DiracSpectrum/DiracSpectrumObject records. They encode no analytic formula or actual operator construction.
The morphism preservation/association theorems delegate to captured arbitrary proposition witnesses. Their names do not assert an equation about eigenvalues, multiplicities or composition.

The next three theorems take M and explicit B or F as hypotheses and return their supplied mapping/index/morphism-compatibility propositions; no independently defined source-to-target relation or arrow map is proved.

dirac_spectrum_realizes_k_index requires M, I and R and returns its supplied spectralObjectRepresentsIndex proposition. dirac_spectrum_k_index_same_class genuinely returns R.bridge.target.value = I.indexClass.value by delegation to the exact reviewed dependency theorem. That equality is a premise of R, not constructed from spectral data.

All fully qualified Folder.Spectral and Folder.DerivedSheaf bindings, explicit/implicit arguments and proof bodies remain unchanged. No review95 candidate provider, historical alternate or namespace alias is substituted.

Full captured SpectralKTheoryBridge, Tensor and CategoricalSpectrum sources and KTheoryIndex/Class/ModuliStackKTheory contexts were read; their semantic limits are recorded in review95. Deeper import environment remains unresolved.
No Lean replay, kernel acceptance, actual spectral/K-theory correspondence, genuine Mathlib functor, index theorem, K-group axioms or project originality is established by this re-export module.
